analysis.title: Antero Resources Corp. (AR): First Take: Mixed Quarter Driven By Soft In-Basin Pricing; Focus on Commercial Strategy and Cost Savings
key_insights: AR missed on 3Q26 earnings. EBITDAX was $634 mn vs FactSet consensus $665 mn and GS estimate $727 mn. Adjusted EPS was $0.83 vs consensus $0.97 and GS $1.16.
Free cash flow before working capital was $212 mn vs GS/consensus estimates of $325/$311 mn. Operating cash flow was $578 mn vs GS $687 mn and consensus $628 mn.
Realized natural gas price was $3.15/Mcf vs GS $3.42/Mcf (-8%) and realized NGLs were $29.36/bbl vs GS $32.29/bbl (-9%). The headline attributes the mixed quarter to soft in-basin pricing.
Costs were better than GS expected. Total cash costs were $2.16/Mcfe vs GS $2.23/Mcfe and production taxes were $0.08/Mcfe vs GS $0.11/Mcfe. These did not offset the lower realized prices.
3Q26 production of 4.23 Bcfe/d was slightly below GS/consensus estimates of 4.27/4.28 Bcfe/d. Capex of $360 mn was in line with estimates at $361 mn.
4Q26 production guidance is ~4.30 Bcfe/d, down from ~4.40-4.50 Bcfe/d prior and below GS/consensus of 4.45/4.44 Bcfe/d. Management expects 15-20 Bcfe of curtailments in 4Q26.
4Q26 production expense guidance is $2.10-$2.20 per Mcfe vs the GS estimate of $2.24/Mcfe. D&C maintenance capex guidance is $325-$350 mn vs GS/consensus of $301/$341 mn.
AR completed 265 MMcf/d of premium-priced supply contracts tied to in-basin demand in Clarington, OH, which the report highlights as part of its commercial strategy.

AR expects to achieve $140 mn of its $300 mn margin enhancement target by mid-2027: $50 mn from optimizing the firm transportation portfolio, $60 mn from the ORRI reversion on July 1, 2026, and $30 mn after the VPP expires on August 1, 2027.
AR repurchased 1.6 mn shares for $56 mn in the quarter.
GS keeps a Buy rating and a $46 12-month price target (unchanged from 1 Oct 2026) against a $42.11 close, implying 9.2% upside. The target uses an 11.0% FCF yield on 2027/2028 estimates.

GS lists questions for the 11 AM ET call: 2027 LPG pricing outlook, gas M&A opportunities, whether hedging outlook changed after recent volatility, cost savings progress and service cost inflation, and what macro conditions would move AR toward a growth strategy in 2027/2028.

market_movers.rationale: GS keeps Buy and the $46 target after a 3Q26 miss on EBITDAX, EPS and FCF. Price target is based on an 11.0% FCF yield on 2027/2028 estimates with $3.50 Henry Hub gas.

earnings_insights: AR 3Q26 EBITDAX reported $634 mn vs FactSet consensus est $665 mn and GS est $727 mn (printed 10/28/2026).
AR 3Q26 adjusted EPS reported $0.83 vs consensus est $0.97 and GS est $1.16. Cash flow per share reported $1.87 vs GS est $2.22 and consensus est $1.99.
AR 3Q26 FCF reported $212 mn (before working capital per the text) vs GS est $325 mn and consensus est $311 mn.
AR 3Q26 total production reported 4,234 MMcfe/d vs GS est 4,270 and consensus est 4,276. Natural gas reported 2,904 MMcf/d, NGLs 215 Mb/d, oil 7 Mb/d.
4Q26 production guidance of ~4.30 Bcfe/d (company guidance) vs ~4.40-4.50 Bcfe/d prior guidance, with 15-20 Bcfe of curtailments expected.
GS 3Q26E EPS in the model table is $1.06 vs the $0.83 reported adjusted EPS. GS 4Q26E EPS is $1.82 and 1Q27E is $1.33 (GS estimates, pre-print).
